General Education Committee Meeting
The General Education Committee (GEC) meets approximately two weeks prior to Faculty Senate meetings to review General Education curricular proposals for recommendation to the Faculty Senate. The following weeks are provided for planning purposes; specific meeting dates will be provided once scheduled.
Items approved by GEC will be included in a report for consideration and approval by the Faculty Senate at its next scheduled meeting.

Faculty Senate meetings are scheduled monthly from 3:00 – 5:00PM during the academic year. Sponsored receptions typically follow the meetings. These are great opportunities to build collegial relationships and network with colleagues from other disciplines. Special Meetings may be called upon due notice.
Meetings are hybrid with a Zoom remote option and the in-person portion held in the Hope Room of the Higgins Welcome Center on the Kinston Campus. Please check this page often for up-to-date meeting locations and Zoom links. In September, December, and April, the General Faculty-Graduate Faculty Meeting directly precedes the Faculty Senate Meeting.

Kuali Curriculum Management (CM) is the system used at URI to manage university-wide curricula, the curriculum approval process, and the official academic catalog.

Kuali CM is the cloud-based system used to manage the curriculum approval process through forms and workflow.
The URI Academic Catalog is built in Kuali and pulls information directly from all course, program, and specialization records.
Kuali CM integrates with eCampus . When a course is approved in Kuali, the information is sent to eCampus and updated for a future term.

Information entered into Kuali curricular forms (course, program, and specialization proposals) flows directly into the catalog and eCampus. It is essential that proposals are written clearly and leave no room for interpretation.

Access to Kuali CM is limited to faculty, Deans, and select administrators and staff. Only faculty members are permitted to submit proposals.
To request access or learn how to log in, visit the Faculty Senate’s Kuali Access page.

The Committee for Research and Creative Activities (henceforth referred to as the “full committee”) shall consist of six faculty senators and five non-senator research-active faculty) and students active, experienced, or concerned with various aspects of research, creative, and scholarly efforts at URI. The Vice President for Research and Economic Development (VPRED) shall be an ex officio (non-voting) member of the committee. The FSEC shall appoint six senators, and the VPRED shall appoint five research-active non- senators. #23-24-21

The full committee shall serve as the representative voice of the university community in all matters related to research, creative, and scholarly activities. It shall seek to improve the environment for research at URI in all ways possible. The Chair of the full committee shall serve as an ex-officio voting member of the Intellectual Property Committee (See University Manual section 5.30.10). The full committee shall form from its membership, a subcommittee, the Competitive Grants Subcommittee, the chair of which shall be appointed from the members of the full committee. The full committee shall meet at least once a month and present reports to the Faculty Senate in December and April and more often as needed. The Competitive Grants Subcommittee shall report to the Faculty Senate at least once annually. #17-18-18, #21-22-37 , #23-24-21, #24-25-19

The Curriculum and Standards Committee (CASC)

The Curriculum and Standards Committee shall comprise six or more faculty members one of whom serves as the chairperson of the General Education committee. The chair of the General Education Committee shall be appointed from the members of the committee. The committee shall consider and make recommendations to the Faculty Senate on the items specifically assigned to it (see By-laws 4.21 to 4.25). The committee shall meet at least once a month and present reports to the Faculty Senate as often as necessary. Joint meetings of the Curriculum and Standards and General Education curriculum committees shall occur early fall and late spring to review and calibrate standards for course review. #17-18-12, #20-21-14 , #21-22-37
